title: PIT-safe revision selection must not prefer stale lexicographic revision tokens
instructions: QUALITY FIX ONLY. Thus for SAME (source,source_record_id,family,metric), a later-visible correction r10 with newer available_at_ms can be discarded in favor of stale r9. Prefer the latest known available revision by availability/observation clocks over provider-specific nonnumeric lexicographic revision tokens; provide deterministic tie-breaking for equal clocks, handling numeric or prefixed numeric revision tokens naturally rather than treating r9 as newer than r10. Add deterministic pytest regression with same source record identity, same effective timestamp, r9 available at T1/observed T1, r10 available at T2/observed T2, T2>T1: at as_of between T1 and T2 r9 remains, at as_of after T2 r10 wins regardless of input order; include same-clock tie behavior and separate source_record_id not collapsed. Existing tests must continue passing. No other production files, no external requests.
